entities.name: Amrou
entities.description: A former paradise whose people were scattered by war; Amrou Haven had become a field of cinders.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A being who, along with the vedalken, salvages most of the large machines, leaving the Auriok only scraps.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard whose mages measure wealth by their servants and where an order seeks to infuse all life with etherium.

entities.name: Dolomarus
entities.description: The Proctor of the Clean, who admires the symmetry of the Dispeller's Capsule.

entities.name: Galanda Feudkiller
entities.description: A speaker on the strength of soul.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A world of giants, kithkin, boggarts and changelings with rocky heights holding fossils.

entities.name: Kataki
entities.description: A kami to whom warriors prayed before the war to sharpen swords and harden armor.

entities.name: Kenzo the Hardhearted
entities.description: A warrior lamenting the loss of Kataki's blessing against the kami hordes.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: A place where a journal describing an otherworldly journey was found.

entities.name: Noboru
entities.description: A master kitemaker who explains how kami absorb the souls in crafted objects.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer who advises Teferi.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A sage who speaks on the difficulty of healing wandering rifts.

entities.name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
entities.description: The great unraveler of spells.

entities.name: Calydd
entities.description: A kithkin farmer.

entities.name: Iquati
entities.description: Creator of the Narcomoeba as a living memory.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: A fallen school whose abandoned magical treasures drew thieves and desperate scholars.

entities.name: Lady Azami
entities.description: A speaker warning of the dangers of knowing a name.

entities.name: Sirislav
entities.description: A Dimir spy who was thwarted near Tin Street Market.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A guild that employs spies.

entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: A market with a latrine pit behind it.

entities.name: Takenuma
entities.description: A place filled with moans of the living, dying and dead.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A savage shard with bottomless tar pits and barbarians.

entities.name: Wyndmoor Street
entities.description: A street whose lamps snuff themselves at midnight.

entities.name: The Book of Other Folk
entities.description: An in-world book commenting on boggarts.

entities.name: Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV
entities.description: An in-world history describing creatures pouring out of warrens.

entities.name: Stovic
entities.description: A village eccentric warning about the ignus.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: A speaker commenting on an expendable yet unkillable goblin.

entities.name: Auntie Grub
entities.description: A boggart whose exploits are well known and the subject of tales.

entities.name: Olly of Goldmeadow
entities.description: A Lorwyn resident complaining about a changeling.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: Home of Olly.

entities.name: Olanti
entities.description: A Muraganda druid.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A primal land with druids.

entities.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
entities.description: A speaker who says the land grows only where the kami will it.

entities.name: Zyd
entities.description: A Kamahlite druid rejecting unnatural weapons.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The world-body that the Riftsweeper vows to protect from beings of the rifts.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A land whose salt was ground into the herd's footprints.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A land whose moss was ground into the herd's footprints.

entities.name: Hurloon
entities.description: A land whose dust was ground into the herd's footprints.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A distant land whose ash was ground into the herd's footprints.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A group that learns from every lesson it teaches.

entities.name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
entities.description: A conduit of justice who dispenses it without ego or remorse.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard whose landscape and ruins are known to its defenders against invaders.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of defending Bant against invaders.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of rage followed by fitting vengeance.

entities.name: Collision of the Shards
entities.description: The collision of the shards, during which entire ways of life disappeared.

entities.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
entities.description: A ruler who claims power over the soul's eternity.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A hydra-god the elves believe sleeps beneath Naya; the Soul of the World.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard beneath which Progenitus is believed to sleep.

entities.name: The Seer's Parables
entities.description: An in-world text describing the demigods.

entities.name: Yare-Tiva
entities.description: Warden of Gramur forest.

entities.name: Gramur forest
entities.description: A forest warded by Yare-Tiva.

entities.name: Grensch
entities.description: A merrow cutthroat whose view of a kithkin stronghold was blocked.

entities.name: Jeorg
entities.description: A Valla battlemaster.

entities.name: Valla
entities.description: Home of the battlemaster Jeorg.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A place that gives up treasure as long as you take its place.

entities.name: Imran
entities.description: A Viridian elder.

entities.name: Viridian
entities.description: A people whose raiment holds the wisdom of generations.

entities.name: Velis Vel
entities.description: Caverns where runes mark new changeling forms.

entities.name: Nulakam the Archivist
entities.description: An archivist who speaks of the ringing spires.

events.summary: The people of Amrou were scattered by war and driven into hiding; Amrou Haven became a field of cinders.
events.quote: The paradise of Amrou Haven had become a field of cinders.

events.summary: The School of the Unseen fell, leaving treasures that drew thieves and scholars.
events.quote: When the School of the Unseen fell, so many magical treasures lay abandoned

events.summary: Sirislav, a Dimir spy, was thwarted and dumped in a latrine pit behind Tin Street Market.
events.quote: And then suddenly I found myself facedown in a latrine pit behind Tin Street Market.

events.summary: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared.
events.quote: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

events.summary: Progenitus, the Soul of the World, returned.
events.quote: The Soul of the World has returned.

relations.quote: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

relations.note: prayed to Kataki before the war
relations.quote: Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor.
